title: Business account application
subtitle: Tell us about the company, upload two documents, and we will come back to you.

entry.title: Apply for a business account
entry.body: Buying for a company works differently from buying for yourself: we agree terms first, then open the account. It takes about ten minutes, and you can stop and come back — everything you enter is saved as you go.
entry.needIdentity: An identity document for whoever signs for the company
entry.needTerms: An idea of the payment terms and volumes you want
entry.resumeBody: You started this on {{date}}. Pick up where you left off.

wizard.saveFailed: That did not save. Nothing has been lost — try again.
wizard.locked: This section is closed while your application is with us.
wizard.lockedByRequest: Only the sections we asked about can be changed right now.
wizard.outstanding_one: {{count}} thing still to do before you can send this.
wizard.outstanding_other: {{count}} things still to do before you can send this.
wizard.conflictBody: This application was saved somewhere else while you were typing. Reload it to see what changed — your text is still on screen until you do.

review.title: Check and send
review.body: Read it back before we do. Once it is with us you can still answer questions, but you cannot rewrite it.
review.blockedBody: We need these before this can go to a reviewer.
review.withdrawConfirm: Withdrawing closes this application. You can start a new one later, and nothing you uploaded is kept.

company.title: The company
company.description: As it appears on your commercial registration, not as people know it.

signatory.title: Who signs
signatory.description: The person who can commit the company to an agreement. We check this against the identity document.

trade_terms.title: Terms you want
trade_terms.description: What you are asking for. What we can offer comes back in the agreement.

logistics.title: Deliveries
logistics.description: How and when food should reach you. None of this is binding — it tells a reviewer what to plan for.

fields.leadTimeDays: Notice you can give, in days

hints.legalName: Exactly as written on the registration document.
hints.tradingName: Leave this empty if it is the same as the registered name.
hints.taxRegistrationNumber: Optional. Leave it empty if the company is not registered for tax.
hints.signatoryTitle: Managing director, finance manager — whatever it says on the paperwork.
hints.requestedCreditLimitMinor: Leave this empty to pay up front. That is a complete answer, not a gap.
hints.leadTimeDays: How many days ahead you can place an order.
hints.deliveryNotes: Gate codes, loading bays, who to ask for.

validation.required: This one is needed before you can send the application.
validation.url: Enter a full web address, starting with http:// or https://.
validation.phone: Enter the number in international form, starting with +.
validation.currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as USD.
validation.tooLong: That is longer than we can store.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Uploads are held privately and are only ever read by the people reviewing this application.
documents.downloadHint: Opens a link that expires in a couple of minutes. We record that it was opened.
documents.uploadFailed: That upload did not go through. Nothing was saved — try again.
documents.unreadableOnDevice: This device cannot read the file's contents, so it cannot be uploaded from here. The web app can.
documents.scanNotice: We do not scan uploads for malware yet. Only send documents you are confident in.

rejection.wrong_document: This is not the document it was filed as.
rejection.incomplete: Pages are missing, or it is only partly filled in.
rejection.mismatch: The details on it do not match the application.
rejection.other: See the message from our team.

scan.infected: Something was found in this file

status.title: Where your application stands
status.reviewerRequests_one: {{count}} thing we have asked you for.
status.reviewerRequests_other: {{count}} things we have asked you for.

draft.label: Not sent yet
draft.body: Nobody has seen this. Finish it and send it when you are ready.

submitted.label: Sent
submitted.body: It is in the queue. Somebody will pick it up — we will write to you when they do.

in_review.label: Being reviewed
in_review.body: Somebody is reading it now. If they need anything they will ask here.

info_requested.label: We need something from you
info_requested.body: Your application keeps its place in the queue. Answer what is below and send it back.

approved.label: Approved
approved.body: We can work with you. We are drawing up the terms now.

agreement_pending.label: Waiting for your signature
agreement_pending.body: The terms are ready. Read them and, if you are happy, accept them — nothing happens until you do.

agreement_signed.label: Signed
agreement_signed.body: We have your acceptance. Setting your account up is the next thing to happen.

provisioning.label: Setting up your account
provisioning.body: This takes a minute or two. You do not need to stay on this page.

provisioned.label: Your account is open
provisioned.body: You can order now. Your prices are the ones in your agreement and nobody else can see them.

declined.label: Not approved
declined.body: We cannot open an account on this basis. What we can say about why is below.

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
withdrawn.body: You closed this application. You can start a new one whenever you like.

agreement.title: Your agreement
agreement.noInvoicingYet: There is no invoicing on the platform yet. A payment term is recorded here; nothing will chase a balance.
agreement.typedNameHint: This stands in for a signature. Type it as it appears on your identity document.
agreement.authority: I am authorised to enter into this agreement for this company.
agreement.honestyBody: This records that you read these terms and accepted them, together with the date, your name and a fingerprint of the exact document you were shown. It is not a qualified or certified electronic signature, and we do not claim it is one.
agreement.verifyBody: Before you accept, we send a code to the address on the account. It is the only thing standing between an agreement and anybody who borrows your screen.
agreement.otpNotVerified: This acceptance was recorded without a code being verified.
agreement.changedBody: The document on screen is no longer the one we hold. Reload it and read it again before accepting.

provisioning.title: Setting up your account
provisioning.body: Five things happen, in order. It is safe to leave this page — nothing stops if you do.
provisioning.doneBody: Your organisation exists and your prices are in place. Nobody outside your company can see them.

errors.notEditable: This cannot be changed at the moment.
errors.sectionRefused: Some of those details belong to another part of the form.
errors.loadFailed: We could not load your application.
